```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rtry)
library(DT)
options(digits = 2)
options(scipen = 4)
```

# Import trait data

First, we load the data:
```{r}
original <- rtry_import("Data/try_data.txt")
```

To comply with co-authorship requests, some records are removed. Remaining data have sufficient coverage.

```{r}
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(DatasetID %in% c(629, 635, 708, 71, 71, 519)) |>
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName) |> 
  filter_out(is.na(TraitID)) |> 
  datatable()

#anthriscus LA
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 4045 & TraitID == 3117) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#chrysosplenium LA
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 12744 & TraitID == 3117) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#daphne SSD
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 16958 & TraitID == 4) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#doronicum H
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 19149 & TraitID == 3106 & StdValue < 1.5) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#hedera H
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 27988 & TraitID == 3106 & StdValue < 1.5) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#ilex H
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 30228 & TraitID == 3106 & StdValue < 1.5) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

#ilex SSD
original |> 
  rtry_select_row(AccSpeciesID == 30228 & TraitID == 4) |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesName, AccSpeciesID, TraitID, TraitName, DatasetID)

original <- original |> 
  rtry_select_row(!DatasetID %in% c(629, 635, 708, 71, 71, 519))
```

We find trait IDs

```{r}
explore <- rtry_explore(original, DataID, DataName, TraitID, TraitName, sortBy = TraitID)

datatable(explore)
```

## Check for treatment, status, health, development

We exclude non-natural treatments

```{r}
status <- rtry_select_row(original, DataID %in% c(327, 413, 1444, 1961)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, sortBy = DataID)

datatable(status)

excluded_treatment <- grepl("chamber|mesocosm|outside|garden|planted|greenhouse",
      original$OrigValueStr, ignore.case = T)


try <- rtry_exclude(original, excluded_treatment, baseOn = ObservationID)
```

The remaining treatments:
```{r}
status <- rtry_select_row(try, DataID %in% c(327, 413, 1444, 1961)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, sortBy = DataID)

datatable(status)
```

Exclude non-adults:

```{r}
excluded_status <- grepl("sapling|seedling", try$OrigValueStr, ignore.case = T)

try <- rtry_exclude(try, excluded_status, baseOn = ObservationID)
```

Remaining statuses:

```{r}
status <- rtry_select_row(try, DataID %in% c(327, 413, 1444, 1961)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, sortBy = DataID)
```

Remove ancillary:

```{r}
try <- rtry_select_row(original, TraitID > 0)
```

`OrigObsDataID` reveals observation connected to a different ID. Remove only duplicates ID already present in the file:

```{r}
duplicates <- rtry_explore(try, DataID, DataName, TraitID, OrigObsDataID) |> 
  pull(OrigObsDataID) |> 
  na.omit()

IDs <- rtry_explore(try, DataID, DataName, TraitID, ObsDataID) |> 
  pull(ObsDataID)

duplicates <- duplicates[duplicates %in% IDs]

try <- rtry_exclude(try, OrigObsDataID %in% duplicates, baseOn = ObsDataID)
```

Check result:

```{r}
explore <- rtry_explore(try, DataID, DataName, TraitID, TraitName, sortBy = TraitID)
```

# Keep relevant sub-traits

```{r}
#exclude trait IDs for generative height and leaflet area
try <- rtry_exclude(try, TraitID %in% c(3107, 3109, 3111, 3113), baseOn = ObsDataID)

#sub-traits to exclude
exclude <- c(2386, 2527, 3730, 3731, 20, 1299, 3645, 3646, 3647, 3648, 
             7216, 7217, 7224, 7225, 7222, 7223)

#check the excluded trait names
explore |> 
  filter(DataID %in% exclude) |> 
  pull(DataName)

#exclude them
try <- rtry_exclude(try, DataID %in% exclude, baseOn = ObsDataID)
```

Check result:

```{r}
explore <- rtry_explore(try, DataID, DataName, TraitID, TraitName, sortBy = TraitID)

#trait names kept
explore |> 
  pull(DataName)
```

# Filter based on error risk 

```{r}
risky <- try |> 
  rtry_select_row(ErrorRisk >= 3) |> 
  rtry_select_col(AccSpeciesName, DataID, DataName, TraitID, TraitName, StdValue, ErrorRisk) |> 
  arrange(AccSpeciesName, DataName)

#will be useful later if there are missing traits
risky_traits <- risky |> 
  distinct(AccSpeciesName, TraitID, TraitName)
```

## Pteridium aquilinum SM

```{r}
rtry_select_row(try, (AccSpeciesID == 44805) & (TraitID ==26)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, ErrorRisk, sortBy = OrigValueStr)
```

1 means "too small to be measured"

## Athyrium filix-femina SM

```{r}
rtry_select_row(try, (AccSpeciesID == 6006) & (TraitID ==26)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, ErrorRisk, sortBy = OrigValueStr)
```

1 means "too small to be measured"

Are there NAs?

```{r}
rtry_select_row(try, is.na(ErrorRisk)) |> 
  rtry_explore(DataID, DataName, OriglName, OrigValueStr, OrigUnitStr, StdValue, Comment, sortBy = OrigValueStr)
```

Two will be converted, three have empty values.

Make a copy, in case some species have few measurements and get removed

```{r}
try_unfiltered <- try
```

Keep observations with error risk < 3

```{r}
try <- rtry_exclude(try, ErrorRisk >= 3, baseOn = ObsDataID)
```

Any species completely removed?

```{r}
species_filter <- try |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesID) |> 
  pull(AccSpeciesID)

species_unfilter <- try_unfiltered |> 
  rtry_explore(AccSpeciesID) |> 
  pull(AccSpeciesID)

species_unfilter[!species_unfilter %in% species_filter]
```

No, keep going.

# Missing stdvalue

```{r}
std_missing <- rtry_select_row(try, is.na(StdValue) & !is.na(OrigValueStr))

std_missing

#convert cm to m
std_missing$StdValue <- parse_number(std_missing$OrigValueStr)/100

std_missing <- std_missing |> 
  rtry_select_row(StdValue > 0)

#exclude empty rows
try <- rtry_select_row(try, complete.cases(TraitID) & complete.cases(StdValue)) |> 
  rtry_bind_row(std_missing) #add the converted values
```

# Hedera helix and Ilex aquifolium

Most of the height measurements for these species represent fully grown individuals, but we have understory records which are for sure below 1.5 m. Check for suitable data or otherwise exclude those values.

## Hedera helix height

All heights < 1.5 in original data

```{r}
hedera_h <- rtry_select_row(original, AccSpeciesID == 27988 & TraitID == 3106 & StdValue < 1.5)

#check the ancillary for those observations
hedera_anc <- rtry_select_row(original, ObservationID %in% hedera_h$`ObservationID`,
                              getAncillary = T) |> 
  filter(TraitID %in% c(3106, NA)) |> 
  arrange(ObservationID) |> 
  select(!c(1:6, 18:20, 24, 25, 29))

#keep useful ancillaries
hedera_anc <- rtry_select_row(hedera_anc, TraitID > 0 | DataID %in% c(193, 235, 413, 1863))

#reference list for hedera height
hedera_ref <- hedera_anc |> 
  distinct(Reference)

#calculate mean height
hedera_h <- mean(hedera_h$StdValue)
```

## Ilex aquifolium height

```{r}
ilex_h <- rtry_select_row(original, AccSpeciesID == 30228 & TraitID == 3106 & StdValue < 1.5)

#check the ancillary for those observations
ilex_anc <- rtry_select_row(original, ObservationID %in% ilex_h$`ObservationID`,
                              getAncillary = T) |> 
  filter(TraitID %in% c(3106, NA)) |> 
  arrange(ObservationID) |> 
  select(!c(1:6, 18:20, 24, 25, 29))

#keep useful ancillaries
ilex_anc <- rtry_select_row(ilex_anc, TraitID > 0 | DataID %in% c(193, 235, 413, 1863))

#reference list for ilex height
ilex_ref <- ilex_anc |> 
  distinct(Reference)

#calculate mean height
ilex_h <- mean(ilex_h$StdValue)
```

# Summary

```{r}
#keep relevant columns
traits <- rtry_select_col(try, ObservationID, ObsDataID, AccSpeciesName, TraitID, 
                              TraitName, StdValue, UnitName) 

#put together traits
traitlist <- rtry_explore(traits, TraitID, TraitName, sortBy = TraitName)

traitlist$trait <- c(rep("LA", 4), rep("SLA", 3), "LN", "PH", "SM", "SSD")

traitlist <- traitlist[, c(2, 4)]

#join coarse trait names

traits <- traits |> 
  left_join(traitlist) |> 
  select(!c(TraitName, TraitID))

risky_traits <- risky_traits |> 
  left_join(traitlist) |> 
  select(!c(TraitName, TraitID))

#list of references for main table
refs <- rtry_select_col(try, Reference) |> 
  distinct()
```

Check if "risky" data have otherwise missing traits:

```{r}
risky_missing <- anti_join(risky_traits, traits)

risky_missing
```

Handle missing traits:

```{r}
risky_missing <- risky_missing |> 
  left_join(traitlist, relationship = "many-to-many", multiple = "all")

risky <- semi_join(risky, risky_missing) |> 
  arrange(AccSpeciesName, TraitName) |> 
  select(AccSpeciesName, TraitName, StdValue) |> 
  left_join(traitlist)
```

Remove "too small to be measured" SM indicator:

```{r}
risky <- risky |> 
  filter(!(trait == "SM" & StdValue == 1))

#references for risky missing

risky_refs <- try_unfiltered |> 
  semi_join(risky) |> 
  distinct(Reference)

risky <- risky |>
  select(!TraitName) |> 
  group_by(AccSpeciesName, trait) |> 
  summarise(StdValue = mean(StdValue))
```

Add units:

```{r}
risky <- traits |> 
  distinct(trait, UnitName) |> 
  right_join(risky)
```

Join risky but otherwise missing traits. Those species are not necessary for the analyses anyway (ferns and saphrophytes):

```{r}
traits <- traits |> 
  bind_rows(risky)
```

Pivot:

```{r}
traits <- traits |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ObservationID, AccSpeciesName),
              names_from = c(trait, UnitName),
              values_from = StdValue, values_fn = mean)
```

Species means:

```{r}
traits <- traits |> 
  select(!ObservationID) |> 
  group_by(AccSpeciesName) |> 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm =T))) |> 
  select(1, 5, 3, 6, 4, 7, 2) #reorder columns
```

Add hedera and ilex:

```{r}
traits[which(traits$AccSpeciesName == "Hedera helix"), "PH_m"] <- hedera_h

traits[which(traits$AccSpeciesName == "Ilex aquifolium"), "PH_m"] <- ilex_h
```

```{r}
traits |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  datatable()
```

# List of References

```{r}
bind_rows(refs, risky_refs, hedera_ref, ilex_ref) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(Reference) |> 
  datatable()
```

# Export

```{r}
write_csv(traits, "Data/try_traits.csv")
```
